title: Hayati Pro Max Watermelon Ice Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Hayati Pro Max Watermelon Ice delivers a cool and juicy vape with fresh fruit flavour and a clean, frosty finish. The Watermelon is soft, sweet, and refreshing, offering a delicately fruity inhale that captures the essence of ripe summer Melon. A burst of menthol on the exhale provides a crisp chill that enhances the fruit’s delicate sweetness, making this an easy-going all-day vape. This e-liquid is made with nicotine salts to provide smoother throat hits and quicker nicotine satisfaction. Best suited to MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping using pod kits and starter devices, its 50VG/50PG blend ensures consistent flavour and vapour production. This flavour is part of the Hayati Pro Max Nic Salt range, inspired by Hayati’s own bestselling disposable vapes and now reimagined in a longer-lasting 10ml format—available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths.
